paragraphs.text: Vexyr is a Phyrexian native to New Phyrexia who had a role as an artificer, part of Ich-Tekik 's legacy.

With Vorinclex's attention elsewhere, the splicer Ich-Tekik turned from crafting mindless predators to building a living legacy. This legacy was Vexyr. Vexyr's body was salvaged from many parts - his body appears to be Sylvok , while the top part of his head is partly Alabaster Host . His hips carry eyestalks from the Chrome Host, and his hands are large the Copper Host claws. Like Ich-Tekik, Vexyr has learned how to build Phyrexian golems .
It is unknown if Vexyr survived the New Phyrexian Invasion .
